# Access Gate

> Create and manage NFT access passes (gates) on Sui: price, uses, soulbound or transferable, pause and freeze. Passes unlock gated services such as the Walrus upload relay or sealed content.

Address: https://sui-access-gate.meddleware.co.uk

## Documentation

- [User guide](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/access-gate/)
- [Reference](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/access-gate/reference)
- [Developer integration](https://meddleware.dev/sui/access-gate/integration)
- [Gateway (wire protocol)](https://meddleware.dev/sui/access-gate/gateway)
